column1: # docs/game/atlas/mizuumi_candidates.tsv — #118: the mizuumi community's player-struct candidates (the 89 offsets of
# 14z-189's working list) against docs/game/atlas/ram.md. offset and batch are MAINTAINED; name, verdict and evidence
# are DERIVED from ram.md by tools/mizuumi_candidates.py (`write`; its docstring holds the rules) and held to it by
# tests/test_mizuumi_candidates.sh — never hand-edited. Seeded 14z-213 (ruled 2026-10-30: "Re-derive, beside atlas").
# The community text stays outside the tree: a name here is only what ram.md itself quotes.
#   offset    the byte offset in the player block (P1 RAM:$FF8400, P2 RAM:$FF8800), +0xNNN as ram.md writes it
#   name      the community name exactly as ram.md quotes it (`mizuumi's "..."`), "-" when ram.md quotes none
#   verdict   one of the vocabulary below
#   evidence  the ram.md row the verdict rests on; every tests/*.sh gate it cites with check ids; "ungated per
#             ram.md" when it says "not yet gated"; the PRG: addresses it cites (no counts: ram.md gives none per PC)
#   batch     the remaining measurement that would move the verdict (B-numbered rig batches, "static
#             decode"); "-" = no source assigns one (not "nothing left to learn"); UNDECIDED = no rule could
#   CONSISTENT       ram.md: "consistent with mizuumi's ..." — measured behaviour agrees; adopted only as
#   OWNER ONLY       ram.md: "consistent with mizuumi's ... as to OWNER only" — the named character's own
#                    code writes the slot; the meaning itself not tested
#   CROSS-CHECKED    ram.md maps the community name onto a byte of one of its own (range) rows
#   COVERED          a ram.md RANGE row documents the byte under its own meaning; the name not compared
#   NOT OBSERVED     ram.md: "mizuumi's ... not observed" — the named owner never wrote it, or wrote only 0
#   NOT ADOPTED      ram.md: "RECORDED; mizuumi's ... NOT adopted" — behaviour recorded, name not established
#   REFUTED IN PART  ram.md refutes part of the community text and finds the rest consistent
#   REFUTED          ram.md: the name REFUTED by measurement
#   NO ROW           ram.md has no row owning or covering the offset — still unmeasured
#   UNDECIDED        a row exists but no rule decides it (never guessed)
